title: add rag agent templates, tool-calling examples, and quickstarts (docs site update)
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: Provide first-class RAG templates and agent/tool-calling quickstarts to reduce friction for developers shipping retrieval-augmented generation and tool-enabled agents. This PR adds runnable examples, templates, and step-by-step docs so teams can bootstrapped reproducible RAG pipelines and agent integrations. Scope: 1) redwood-examples/rag-templates: three opinionated templates (basic, multi-source, streaming) and README explaining best practices and config knobs; 2) redwood-examples/agents/tool-calling: email and calendar agent examples (Python + TypeScript snippets) demonstrating function/tool calling with structured outputs and retries; 3) docs site updates: two new quickstarts (RAG quickstart, Agent tool-calling quickstart), API usage snippets, sidebar updates, and cross-links to examples; 4) small Docusaurus config and snippet additions for copy/paste. Checklist: - [x] add runnable RAG templates and tests - [x] add agent tool-calling examples and README - [x] author two docs quickstarts and add to sidebars - [x] validate snippets in CI docusaurus build - [x] add Linear link and changelog entry. Regression considerations: docs-only and examples; no runtime changes. Related: ENG-4821, DOC-313. Testing: unit and example smoke tests run in CI; docusaurus build verified locally and in CI. Merge notes: squash-merged after approvals and CI green.
